steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All right, keep in touch. Let me know if catch wind of anything.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Just press the third button. Mhm.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Hmm? Dr. {@nickname}?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Where's Amiya?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...You actually let her go alone.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Whatever, at least someone is protecting her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I suppose you wouldn't be able to do anything even if you went with her. I'll let you off the hook this time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Did you also come back by yourself?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Oh, Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You also need to take better precautions to stay safe. We won't always have the luxury of reliable local guides.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya will not be in Lungmen for a long time, since she has other missions to do.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You'll have to face her again.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...If I were you, I'd make sure to tell her the things that I couldn't say before.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, Doctor?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Were you waiting for me this whole time...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sorry to have kept you waiting.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hmm? My complexion looks different from when I left?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Some things happened.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I feel like...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Perhaps Madam Ch'en has her own way of looking at things.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even though her words are harsh, and she has done things that I can't accept...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Maybe... the difference between us isn't that big.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She has her responsibilities.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh... I understand now...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She also has her share of burdens to bear.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Perhaps I also...

options: Amiya, you also have plenty of responsibilities yourself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is that so...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... just didn't have other choices.

options: At least you saw your choices through.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I suppose all these consequences were the results of my persistence.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, there's no need... to try to comfort me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Actually, I'm well aware of this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But what I don't know...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What I don't know, is how long we have to keep going before this world begins to change.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, what I do know for sure...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is that I won't give up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll always bear the consequences of my actions, because... I chose this path.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Will you... stay by my side?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even though... this guilt will always stay with me...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The regret of not being able to bring everyone with me. The regret of not being able to save my friends...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I must face reality.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: With everyone in Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hmm? A message from Dr. Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit? Did you need something?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, I've received communications from a few recon teams.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The situation has changed for the worse.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay, I'll be right there.
